messages:
mira (eng-ml): Heads-up — we need a short docs PR to consolidate guidance for throttling/errors: request throttling (429s), request timeouts, and context-limit failures. Want examples for: Python + Node SDK retries (respect Retry-After if present), fallback to a smaller quantized model, and a minimal streaming abort example.

alex (docs): Got it. I'll draft a single troubleshooting section under /errors that covers all three. Can you paste exact SDK call shapes we should show? also prefer small snippets (3–6 lines) + one fuller example.

sam (eng-runtime): Example logic we use server-side is basically: check status (429), if Retry-After header -> sleep that many s then retry, else exponential backoff with jitter up to 3 attempts. On persistent 429s fallback to model: "redwood-mini-1" with same prompt. Also include a metric to signal fallback. Quick pseudo: 

```python
for attempt in range(1,4):
    resp = client.generate(model=model, prompt=prompt)
    if resp.status_code == 200:
        return resp.json()
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        ra = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
        wait = float(ra) if ra else min(2**attempt + random(), 10)
        time.sleep(wait)
# fallback
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-mini-1', prompt=prompt)
```

sam (eng-runtime): For Node it's similar — check resp.headers['retry-after'], use setTimeout and retry. Also add example that reduces max_tokens/context window when context-limit error returned (we return 413 or a specific 'context_length_exceeded' error code).

jen (eng-platform): Small note: SDK method name changed last month from `generate` -> `createCompletion` in the Node v2 SDK. Add a brief callout: "if using older SDKs, method may be named `generate`". Also include a streaming abort snippet: `controller.abort()` if fetch-based stream.

alex (docs): Perfect. I'll include: 1) a compact retry snippet for Python and Node, 2) full example with backoff+fallback to smaller model, 3) streaming abort snippet, 4) short troubleshooting table mapping error -> suggested action (429 -> wait/retry/fallback; timeout -> increase client timeout or use streaming; context limit -> trim prompt or use embeddings+retrieval).

mira (eng-ml): For the context-limit section: include a pointer to our prefix/KV cache recommendation: when users hit context limits, suggest saving long history to KV and only send rolling context + summary. Maybe a tiny example showing how to send a system summary + last 2 turns.

alex (docs): Will do. Drafting now. tagging you all for review in a PR in ~30m. wanted to confirm: do we call the smaller fallback model `redwood-mini-1` in docs or is there a canonical label?

sam (eng-runtime): Use `redwood-mini-1` for examples. For enterprise customers we sometimes show `<fallback-compatible-model>` as placeholder — maybe include both: concrete example + generic placeholder.

alex (docs): Good call. I'll push a draft and link it here.

docs-bot: PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (draft) — title: "errors: add throttling/timeouts/context-limit troubleshooting + SDK snippets"

alex (docs): PR is up. Ping me fixes inline or leave comments. I'll push the final after reviews.

mira (eng-ml): Quick nit: can we add a one-liner recommending billing-aware fallbacks? e.g., "if cost is a concern, consider using a smaller model as primary for certain endpoints and reserve high-cost models for re-renders".

jen (eng-platform): Also add an ops note: when suggesting retries, always prefer honoring Retry-After and cap retries to 3 by default. SLO teams want that in writing.

alex (docs): Added both notes in the draft. Anything else?

sam (eng-runtime): Add a tiny example of parsing `x-rate-limit-reset` or `x-rate-limit-remaining` for proactive throttling (if header exists we've found it helps). One-liner is fine.

alex (docs): Will add. Final checks: README link to SDK migration guide? we should add link to the Node SDK rename note.

docs-bot: linked issue #225 (sdk-breaking-changes) in PR description.

jen (eng-platform): LGTM — leave a follow-up task to translate snippets to curl for the troubleshooting page. Some users prefer curl examples.

alex (docs): Yep — adding curl as follow-up. Thanks everyone, will merge after two +1s.

mira (eng-ml): Thanks — leaving review now.

sam (eng-runtime): quick test note: when reproducing 429 locally, use `X-RateLimit-Simulate: 1` header on our sandbox to trigger throttling behavior. Add that tip?

alex (docs): Good one — adding as a dev-testing tip.

jen (eng-platform): done, merging when green. :rocket:
